column1: # notes: Host time to enqueue the work of one frame (steady_clock
column2: no synchronisation inside). Each side owns its frame copy and its output. Everything a side does for a frame is timed
column4: because the crop locations may change on every image: NPP computes the source pointer of every crop in the call; FastNPP fills its descriptor and ROI arrays and builds its operations in the call. NPP's batched-resize descriptors point at NPP's own images with full-image ROIs and are set up once.
